rows.medi_said: Is- is متوتر only for nervous ... Yeah maybe stressed is a better word. ... I don't know. ما بتذكر.
rows.why: He could not recall 'stressed' (sheet: stressed / under pressure | Mad8oo6 | مضغوط) and Amal supplied it - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: متأكد إنه أنا ... أتعلم-- آآآ، بتعلمه؟
rows.why: He asked whether he had learned it using a present form; Amal recast to past تعلمتها (with -ha for the feminine word).

rows.medi_said: Would you say أنا كامل نسيت-- نسيتو؟ ... can you say كامل نسيتو؟ I completely forgot.
rows.why: He asked if كامل works for 'completely'; Amal said no and gave كليًا - an answered how-to-say question.

rows.medi_said: The مرجة emotions. مرجة. Hold on. مرجة is for future.
rows.why: He misheard her نراجع as مرجة and thought it was a future marker; Amal said No and repeated نراجع - a listening misread.
Asked what season it is (Sept 21, first day of autumn), he said ربيع (spring); Amal said مش ربيع and supplied خريف (sheet: autumn / fall | 5areef).
بنطلون is masculine; he used the feminine adjective خضرا and Amal recast to أخضر.

rows.chat: el-yoam a2al bard bas lissa bard
rows.why: Best reading: after أقل the noun برد (cold) is needed, not the adjective بارد; her chat writes a2al bard / lissa bard; not voiced.
Talking about his own city he said عندهم (they have); Amal recast عنا and he repeated عندنا.
After 11+ the noun is singular; Amal said 'after ten, يوم'.
The thirty days are plural; he used singular بتغير and Amal's English 'They change' prompted the plural (her chat byet8ayyaru).

rows.medi_said: أكلت الـ pizza دول آآآ الـ آخر الأسبوع.
rows.amal_said: The pizza that remained. That remained from أخر الأسبوع.
rows.chat: akalet el-pizza illi dallat min 2aa5er el-usboo3
rows.why: First word of an idafa takes no el-; Amal recast 'from أخر الأسبوع' (chat min 2aa5er el-usboo3). He repeated الأخر الأسبوع at 15:00 - same slip, filed once.
rows.english: from the end of the week

rows.medi_said: عادة مدينتي هادي، بس لما شي بيصير كل الـ fire department وambulance آجوا.
rows.why: Habitual 'usually ... they come' needs a present b- verb; he used past آجوا and Amal recast بيجو.
lamma drops the b- on the next verb; he kept بيصير and Amal did not remark on it.

rows.amal_said: One piece. Pizza is one. ... Pizza is woman ... feminine.
rows.why: The verb must match pizza (feminine singular); he used plural دلوا, Amal said 'Pizza is one... feminine', he fixed to ضلت.

rows.medi_said: عشان جايبة لي pizza. ... دائمًا جايبة لي pizza.
rows.why: He meant 'felt like pizza' (sheet: i feel like / in the mood for | Jaay 3ala bali) but said جايبة لي (bringing me); Amal laughed and recast كان جاي على بالك.
Adjective goes after the noun; her chat el-peporony el-7araam; her voiced الحرام was a laughing echo, not a fix.
Wrong form of dry (sheet: dry | Naashef | ناشف); he offered نشاف with a question and Amal recast ناشف.

rows.medi_said: So if you ask for a pastry, do you say واحد حلو؟ حلوة؟ أو واحدة حلوة؟
rows.amal_said: يعني كعكة. ... بسكوتة، كعكة، خلص احكي Pastry.
rows.why: He asked how to say pastry; Amal supplied كعكة / بسكوتة.
Amal as barista is female; chat writes astannaaki (-ki) but her voiced استناك only fixed the sound, so the gender ending was let pass.
'Its price' needs the possessive ending, not el-; Amal said 'Its price' and he tried حقو.
Coffee (قهوة) is feminine so the ending is -ha; Amal: 'قديش حقها. Cuz it's coffee.'

rows.medi_said: أدفع أطفالهم ما credit card ما... min
rows.amal_said: أدفع. You use the credit card to pay. So what do you use? Which preposition? ... B.
rows.why: Paying 'with' a card uses bi-; he tried ma3/min, Amal asked which preposition and said B, he said أدفع بالـ credit card.

rows.amal_said: أدفع عن. Pay for. Like you pay for me for example. بدفع عنك.
rows.why: He wanted 'pay for them'; Amal had said لا at 25:05 and gave دفع عن for 'pay for' (la- = pay to).

rows.amal_said: You were right هذي الأكلة. هذي is for feminine.
rows.why: أكلة is feminine so it takes هذي; Amal named the rule and he repeated هذي الأكلة.
أكلة is feminine; chat mish zaakye, voiced not fixed.

rows.medi_said: Is she, is she غلط بي... And it would be بي ال or
rows.why: 'Something wrong with it' uses fi + ending; he tried bi, Amal prompted 'In it' then فيها.

rows.medi_said: Hamet, uh, hamha mura oo hamida.
rows.amal_said: خلص إنت هلأ you're now describing the taste so it's more.
rows.why: The adjectives describe طعم (masculine), not the shawarma; Amal explained and he said tam mur oo hamid.
rows.english: its taste is bitter and sour

rows.medi_said: so if I say I'm famous at cooking, would it be a-ana mash-mashhur bi-ut-bi atbuk without the bi, right?
rows.amal_said: في. في or be. في، mm, the noun. Noun is طبخ.
rows.why: After bi/fi use the noun of the action; he built it with the verb أطبخ and Amal said 'the noun. Noun is طبخ'.

rows.medi_said: ana bazun innu hadi mish lazim.
rows.amal_said: هذي ... مش لا-- إنه ما كان لازم، صح.
rows.chat: bas ana bazonn enno ma kaan laazem
rows.why: Washing the rice was past advice ('it wasn't necessary'); Amal recast ما كان لازم and he repeated makan lazim.

rows.medi_said: il-roz hon mish il-- is not, yeah, mish il-roz fi Iran.
rows.chat: el-ruzz hoan mish zayy el-ruzz bi Iran
rows.why: He left out the word 'like' (زي); Amal said 'it's not like' and he added zay.
rows.english: the rice here is not like the rice in Iran

rows.medi_said: il-shirika ili bi, bibi'u, ishna bibi'?
rows.why: شركة is feminine so the verb is بتبيع; Amal named it and he said 'femina. Bitbi'a'.
Same subject شركة (feminine); he used the he-form bigassel and Amal recast بتغسل.

rows.amal_said: لا، لا، لا. ما بيطبخه، بيخليه ... يفشفش
rows.why: A plain statement needs b-; Amal's 'لا' was about the fact (hot water does not cook rice), so the missing b- was let pass.

rows.medi_said: u marat ana lama ana kasul ana...
rows.why: Amal prompted بكون before the adjective after lamma and he said 'Lama ana bakun kasul' (note: B8 says leaving it out after lamma is not strict).
Plain present needs b-; Amal recast بستعمل.

rows.medi_said: الـ— أساهم الـ، the rice cooker.
rows.amal_said: ماكينة. We didn't learn ماكينة. ... ماكينة الرز.
rows.why: He fell back to English for rice cooker; Amal supplied ماكينة and said they had not learned it - a didn't-know (engine wrote أساهم for basta3mel).
After the lamma clause the main verb gets its b- back; Amal recast بعمله.
طريق is road (sheet: road / way / route | 6ariq); 'the long way/method' is الطريقة; Amal recast.
طريقة is feminine and the phrase needs el- on the adjective; chat el-tari2a el-taweela, voiced only mm-hmm.
Plain present needs b-; Amal recast بطبخه.
After عشرين the noun is singular; Amal repeated عشرين and he then said دقيقة (engine wrote دايّة, likely da2aaye2).
Sheet: butter | Zibdeh | زبدة; زبدية is a bowl; Amal recast زبدة (and again at 46:53).

rows.medi_said: لازم أحط شوي زيت، uh، في الـ تحت الطنجرة.
rows.chat: laazem a7ut shwai zait fi el-tunjara
rows.why: el- on the first word of an idafa; not voiced.
rows.english: under / at the bottom of the pot

rows.medi_said: الـ تحت، الـ تحت تاني. ... الـ آخر تاني؟
rows.amal_said: لا، لا تحت is just under. ... لا. ... بالعكس ... أو عكس الـ
rows.why: For 'the other end' he used تحت (under) and آخر; Amal said no and gave عكس (sheet: opposite | 3aks).

rows.amal_said: عكس الملعقة. ... بس ملعقة spoon ... مغرفة.
rows.why: مقلى is a pan (sheet: pan | Ma2la); he meant the spoon/ladle (sheet: spatula / ladle | Ma8rafa); Amal recast ملعقة then مغرفة. Engine wrote أساهم for basta3mel.
rows.english: the other end of the ladle

rows.why: First word of an idafa takes no el-; Amal recast عكس الملعقة.
rows.english: the other end of the spoon

rows.medi_said: u batfukh al roz laa aktar min thalath, uh, saa. ... no, three hours.
rows.why: 3-10 take a plural noun; he said thalath saa(3a) and Amal recast ثلاث ساعات.
For 'low temperature' he said asir (short/small); Amal supplied واطية (sheet: low | Waati).

rows.medi_said: Sot tawil or sot asir nar?
rows.why: For 'quiet/low fire' he tried صوت (sound/voice); Amal said مش صوت, calm (sheet: calm | Haadi).
Adjective goes after the noun and takes the feminine; Amal recast نار هادية and he repeated Nar hadi.
Sheet: cooked/done (m) | Mistwi; he said mishtihi (مستحي = shy) and Amal recast مستوي, asking what مستحي means.
He built 'the bottom of the rice' with el- on the first word; Amal recast الرز من تحت and he repeated it.
'We Iranians' takes el-; Amal recast إحنا الإيرانيين and he used it (ihna al-Iraniyin).

rows.medi_said: Is ali I can say or bialy or mi-mi-mit? ... Like ali is fried, right?
rows.amal_said: مقلي is fried. بس مقلي is different than crispy. ... Crunchy يعني بقرش.
rows.why: He asked if مقلي means crispy; Amal said they had not learned crispy and gave بقرش.

rows.medi_said: awali is, awali is country, right?
rows.why: He asked if awali means country; Amal supplied دولة (sheet: country | Dawle).

rows.medi_said: bas il ta'am mashhoor, uh, min Iran.
rows.why: 'Famous in Iran' uses fi; Amal said فيه and he said Fi Iran.
3ind takes ma, not mish; Amal recast ما عنا and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: I agree. Hold on. How do I say I agree?
rows.amal_said: We didn't learn agree. ... معك حق.
rows.why: He asked how to say I agree; Amal taught معك حق.

rows.amal_said: لا، بس one L. Where do I put the L؟ It's just one.
rows.why: Only the last word of an idafa takes el-; Amal said 'one L' and he said ta'am il samak.
rows.english: the taste of the fish is spicy

rows.medi_said: أنا حكيت عن الـ rice كتير.
rows.why: English rice in an Arabic sentence; sheet: rice | Ruz | رز | ruz; let pass (pre-ruled AR-1933: do not correct).
rows.english: I talked about rice a lot

rows.amal_said: أحسن من كل الدنيا؟ ... you mean the best in the world؟ ... So أحسن رز في الدنيا، أو بالدنيا.
rows.why: 'The best X' = أحسن + noun + في; he made a comparison with من, Amal recast أحسن رز في الدنيا and he repeated it.
rows.english: our rice is the best in the world

rows.why: 3ind takes ma not mish, and he meant 'you all' (Palestine), -kom; Amal recast ما عندكم.
'Many restaurants' needs the plural; let pass here (Amal later prompted 'Restaurants' at 1:06:06).
Superlative أحسن goes before the noun; Amal said 'The best first' and he said أحسن مطعم.
He meant restaurants (plural); Amal said 'Restaurants' and he said مطاعم إيرانيين (also dropped the wrong el-).

rows.medi_said: مين بيدفع؟ Hold on. مين بيدفع؟ Who pays?
rows.why: He misheard her بيفتح as بيدفع; Amal corrected 'Opens، بيفتح'.
He started يفـ then said دفدوا (mix of دفع/فتح, maybe engine); Amal recast بيفتحوا; he then argued for past tense.

rows.medi_said: Iranian fee UAE bas el akil la, el Arabin.
rows.why: Invented plural Arabin for Arabs (العرب); Amal answered شيعني? about meaning, not the form.

rows.medi_said: uh, el akil zai el akil Arabi.
rows.why: A definite noun's adjective takes el- too; let pass.
Amal asked the word for conversation; he said ma ba'rif and she supplied محادثة (sheet: conversation practice | Mu7aadase).
